name: Surefooted Nomad
body:
Your years of wandering have granted you a sure foot.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Acrobatics 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You may ignore the first 5 feet of difficult terrain you encounter per turn and treat it as if it were normal terrain. This allows you to charge through at least 5 feet of difficult terrain.
